Name: Ithra
Summary: Ithra the Israelite was the father of Amasa by Abigail, David's sister. Amasa commanded Absalom's army and was later murdered by Joab.
KeyStory: Ithra fathered the commander who led a revolt and was murdered for it.
RelatedPeople: Amasa, Son of Ithra; Abigail, Daughter of Nahash
LifeLesson: A father's name rides on a son's divided loyalties.
